C0.quote: Voting behavior in one-shot and iterative multiple referenda
C0.note: The paper is an experiment on voting by majority on binary issues, one-shot and iterated. The body text is extracted as a letter-shifted cipher (each letter is one step off). I decoded it to code it, and quotes below are copied from the garbled text.

C1.quote: Hm sghr o‘odq vd otqrtd ‘m dwodqhldms‘k ‘ooqn‘bg
C1.note: Decoded: 'In this paper we pursue an experimental approach'. Lab experiments with human subjects are the main results. Rationality and dominated choices (SB) and average social welfare (WD) are secondary.

C2.1.value: votes (a vote on each binary issue; votes cast simultaneously or iteratively)
C2.1.quote: unshmf bnmrhrsr ne ‘rjhmf d‘bg unsdq sn b‘rs ‘ unsd

C2.2.quote: unshmf bnmrhrsr ne ‘rjhmf d‘bg unsdq sn b‘rs ‘ unsd
C2.2.note: Each voter casts a yes/no vote on each of two binary issues, with majority rule per issue. This is none of the listed formats.

C2.3.note: Decoded: 'Voters' preferences are captured by payoffs'. Preferences are given as payoff/utility matrices.

C2.4.note: Preferences are given as utility matrices. Votes are separate choices that can deviate from rational (dominant-action) votes.

C3.1.note: Subjects choose votes freely and the paper studies deviations from rationality. Welfare is computed from held payoffs and does not assume that votes are sincere.

C4.1.note: The input format is binary votes on issues (OTH), not RANK, WEAK, APPR, DICH or PAIR.

C4.2.note: The term dichotomous preferences is not used.

C5.1.quote: vd enbtr nm sgd ‘udq‘fd rnbh‘k vdke‘qd
C5.1.note: Decoded: 'we focus on the average social welfare'. The paper also evaluates Condorcet efficiency.

C5.2.quote: vd enbtr nm sgd ‘udq‘fd rnbh‘k vdke‘qd
C5.2.note: Welfare is the average of the payoffs (held utilities) that voters receive from the outcome. Payoffs are defined separately from votes.

VOT.note: Human subjects are paid by the outcome. In one-shot voting they know only their own payoffs. In iterative voting they observe previous vote tallies, so I coded PARTIAL.

ORG.note: The experimenter fixes the protocol and takes no in-model action.

C7.1.note: Only one agent type (voters) is present.

C8.1.note: Rationality is defined via dominant actions. Iterative voting with revision of votes after seeing the outcome is also studied.
